messages:
alyssa: FYI onboarding seraph-13b-lite (community fork) for evals this week. Need perf sweep + quant tests. Priority: medium -> want to validate p95 < 150ms @ batch1 for ctx128.

mike: @alyssa got it. do we have baseline numbers vs oak-13b? :thinking: 

alyssa: baseline from dev is oak-13b int8 p95=140ms @ ctx128 batch1, tokens/sec=1200 on a40. We'll produce full sweep.

sanjay: I'll own the throughput/latency sweep. plan: ctx 128/512/2048, batch sizes [1,2,4,8], concurrency 1/4. Will run unquant, int8, int4.

lina: I'll handle quality regressions + eval sets. Have a prompt set (500 prompts) for summarization & code. Will compare rouge/acc & EM.

alyssa: rough checklist:
- perf sweep (sanjay)
- quant smoke (mike)
- quality eval (lina)
- infra config (gpu mem + kv cache priming) (sanjay)
- rollback gating: if int4 quality delta > 2% on rouge OR p95 > 250ms -> block

mike: starting quant smoke now. running: 
```bash
bench_tool --model seraph-13b-lite --batch-sizes 1,2,4,8 --ctx 128,512,2048 --quant auto --warmup 50
```

perf-ci-bot: Initial smoke finished: unquant p95=145ms (ctx128,b1), int8 p95=152ms, int4 failed OOM on ctx2048 with batch>2. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/1768001234

sanjay: noted OOM on int4@2048. i'll add mem profile run: 
```bash
mem_profiler --model seraph-13b-lite --ctx 2048 --batch 2 --quant int4
```

lina: quick eval: int4 macro-rouge delta = -0.8% vs unquant on summarization, int8 delta = -0.2%. Code generation tests ok but some longer completions truncate under int4.

alyssa: decision: proceed with int8 onboarding as candidate; int4 needs more work (memory optimizations). Sanjay, add a short follow-up to try prefix-KV cache priming and offload config. Mike, can you re-run int4 with kv-priming and reduce batch? 

mike: yea will try kv-priming + batch2 on int4 and post results by EOD. @perf-ci-bot can you schedule nightly stability run? :calendar:

perf-ci-bot: Scheduled nightly stability sweep at 03:00 UTC. Will post summary thread.

sanjay: added action item: create a perf board card and tag infra for potential offtload; will ping infra.

alyssa: thanks team — will combine numbers into onboarding doc and propose canary route to dedicated for int8. :tada:
